context_requirements: Functional metabotropic glutamate receptor signaling, especially GRM7, which is not a canonical driver in these nine lines
Neuronal or neuroendocrine lineage context for robust glutamate receptor-linked transcriptional programs
Expression of GRM7 or related mGlu receptors above a threshold sufficient to engage downstream signaling
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that matches known mGlu receptor agonist/antagonist responses
GRM7-dependent rescue or reversal by a selective mGlu7 antagonist/agonist
